answer: Identity Orchard limits each person to one account, so a voyage requires a unique biological sample to prove you are not a duplicate. The enforcement rule is that each new identity must pay a one-time cost in the form of a small, non-refundable donation of personal data. An attacker pays a high per-identity cost in data privacy, making the attack economically unviable. Nectar flows from the orchard to sustain the journey.
